ValidationRule.description: ALF-RS-08 FR2: a 3-day contract is the no-deposit path, a 7-day contract the deposit path. Stops the two being combined. VIP / Extended is exempt - its duration comes from the approved extension, not from whether a deposit was taken.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(AF_ContractType__c, "3-Day (No Deposit)"), NOT(ISBLANK(AF_DepositAmount__c)), AF_DepositAmount__c > 0 ), AND( ISPICKVAL(AF_ContractType__c, "7-Day (Deposit)"), OR(ISBLANK(AF_DepositAmount__c), AF_DepositAmount__c <= 0) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Contract type and deposit do not match: a 3-Day (No Deposit) reservation must have no deposit, and a 7-Day (Deposit) reservation must have a deposit greater than zero.
